gloss: scratch paper; blank side of used paper

definitions.gloss: scratch paper; the unused back side of printed paper
definitions.explanation: paper that has been used on one side and is reused for notes or drafts on the blank side

notes:
{裏紙|うらがみ} refers to paper that has been used on one side and is reused on the blank back side.

WRITING:
⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back side) + ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦メモ{用紙|ようし}→メモ用紙：29326_memoyoushi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: use as memo paper
- ⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再利用|さいりよう}→再利用：18649_sairiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: reuse misprinted paper
- ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧: scratch paper for calculations

WORKPLACE CULTURE:
Using {裏紙|うらがみ} is encouraged in many Japanese offices and schools as an eco-friendly practice to reduce paper waste.

WATCH OUT:
Be careful not to use paper containing confidential (⟦{機密|きみつ}→機密：13179_kimitsu⟧) information as scratch paper.

- ⟦{再利用|さいりよう}→再利用：18649_sairiyou⟧: reuse, recycling
